costume.name: Celestial Sorcerer
costume.description: A deep blue robe and pointed hat traced with silver constellations, tied with a simple silver belt.
costume.alt: Deep blue pointed hat and long robe embroidered with silver constellations, silver rope belt, moon pendant, and black boots

pieces.name: Blue celestial robe and pointed hat set
queries: adult blue celestial wizard robe hat set
pieces.styleNotes: One merchant-confirmed set supplies both the long robe and pointed hat. Blue/silver foil or blue/gold moon-and-star decoration approximates the dense silver constellation embroidery. No verified option reproduces the generated dense silver constellation embroidery. The two higher-priced sets use gold stars and moons. The middle set is available only in XX-Large. The handmade premium set needs 2-5 weeks of production and was variant-verified only in Blue/M.

matches.reason: Set includes open-front tunic robe and matching pointed hat; 100% polyester. The actual photo shows dark blue fabric, large gold/yellow stars and moons, and silver trim. These are bold appliques, rather than fine silver constellations. Only the listed XX-Large variant is available; One Size is sold out. Beard and shoes in the photo are not listed as included. Merchant ships Monday-Friday from Chicago.

Blue set includes a pointed hat and open-front tunic robe with an inset cover. The photo shows a brighter blue and metallic silver celestial foil print, rather than navy velvet with stitched constellations. Standard/Blue is $89.99; XXL costs $99.99 and is excluded at this price. Beard, staff and crystal ball are not listed as included. Merchant ships Monday-Friday from Chicago.

Made-to-order heavy velvet robe with matching lined wizard hat. Blue/M US letter was selected in the live merchant page at $500 with Add to basket enabled. Merchant asks for chest and neck-to-floor measurements. Actual photos show dark blue velvet with gold moon/star embroidery and gold trim, rather than silver constellations; the pictured design is an example and each piece is custom. The underlayer is not listed as included. Production is 2-5 weeks before shipping from the UK; US shipping is offered. This is orderable production capacity, not a ready-to-ship garment.

pieces.name: Silver cord or rope belt
pieces.styleNotes: Tie a silver cord around the robe and leave long ends visible. Tassels most closely preserve the image. The middle belt uses metal end caps rather than tassels. The premium belt is a wider cummerbund.

matches.reason: Silver PU faux-leather cord with interfaced core and silver hardware, 6 mm wide. M - 85in and Silver hardware were selected on the live merchant page: $32.90, Add to basket enabled. Other lengths are excluded because their final variant prices were not checked. This has metal end caps and no tassels, so it preserves the silver tie-belt shape with a simpler finish. Ships from California; US shipping is offered. Custom sizing adds $3 and is excluded.

One ready belt is listed available at $26. Hand-braided white/silver polyamide and metallic polyester yarn, about 7 mm wide. Total length is 240 cm including tassels; seller says it best fits a 70-80 cm waist for two wraps. The tassels are looser and finer than the generated belt. Ships from Ukraine and offers US shipping; dispatch time is not stated. Custom lengths need a separate seller arrangement and are not included at this price.

Silver silk-cord belt with silk tassels, made in Italy. Merchant lists one fully adjustable size up to 45 inches and a 2.15-inch strap width. Its wide stacked-cord cummerbund construction differs from the narrow single rope in the costume image. Live feed lists the orderable one-size belt at $395. No production lead time is stated; shipping timing must be checked at checkout.

pieces.name: Black boots
pieces.styleNotes: Low-heeled black boots ground the robe. Plain tall boots substitute for the generated embroidered ankle boots. Budget stock is verified only in S. Premium stock is limited to sizes 7-10. None has the generated silver boot embroidery.

matches.reason: Distressed black faux leather with decorative lacing and buttons; inner zipper, 1.5-inch flat heel and rubber lug sole. Shaft height is 16-17 inches excluding the heel. The tall black shape suits the robe, but the buttons and lacing are more steampunk than the image. All listed S-XL variants are available at $120.95. These are grouped boot sizes; use the merchant size chart. No production lead time is stated.

Black PU knee-high costume boots with a low heel and inner side zipper. They are plain, without the generated boot embroidery. Current merchant markup confirms $67.95 USD, purchasable=true and in_stock_attributes=[28768]; option 28768 is S. Only S is included. M/L/XL appear in the form but are outside that in-stock list. Check the merchant size chart for this grouped boot size. No dispatch lead time is stated.

Black leather pull-on boots with a low heel, square toe and leather pull loops. The shaft is 15 inches at the back, plus a 3-inch front rise. These are taller and plainer than the generated embroidered boots. Sizes 7, 8, 9 and 10 are available at $269.95; 11-13 are sold out and excluded. No production lead time is stated.

pieces.name: Silver moon pendant necklace
pieces.styleNotes: A visible silver crescent hangs over the robe. Compare pendant scale and orientation before choosing. The middle pendant is only 8 x 9 mm. The lower and upper price options hang with tips downward.

matches.reason: Italian-made .925 sterling-silver necklace with rhodium finish. Pendant face is 8 x 9 mm and chain adjusts from 16 to 18 inches. It is a much smaller, open-outline crescent than the statement pendant in the costume image. The live merchant feed lists the single variant available at $72. No production lead time is stated.

Silver-color crescent pendant and dainty rope chain, both stainless steel. Pendant diameter is 1 inch, with a lobster clasp. All four stated chain-length variants are orderable at $54. The pendant hangs with its tips downward, unlike the sideways crescent in the generated image. The feed permits purchase but does not track a physical inventory count. No dispatch lead time is stated.

Handcrafted .925 sterling-silver crescent necklace, made in NYC. All listed chain lengths are orderable at $118. Its tips hang downward and its crescent is thin and smooth, rather than the textured sideways moon in the generated image. Each necklace is made after ordering; merchant requests about two weeks plus shipping time. US shipping is offered. Orderable production is not ready-to-ship stock.
